_README: MF_ID -> AMC display-name map for the AMFI TER feed (data_pipeline/sources/amfi_ter.py). The TER JSON rows carry NO AMC field, only a base Scheme_Name, so this map provides the AMC used to scope the TER->funds join (prevents cross-AMC base-name collisions, e.g. two AMCs both having a 'Large Cap Fund'). MF_ID is AMFI's internal mutual-fund-house id. IDs are SPARSE (most of 1..120 are empty/dead). Values are curated from live scheme-name samples on 2026-06-15 (FY 2026-2027, Month 06-2026). NOTE several IDs whose alphabetically-first scheme is an ETF/FOF with a non-AMC brand name (e.g. MF_ID 20's first row is 'BHARAT 22 ETF' but the house is ICICI Prudential; MF_ID 47's first row is 'Bharat Bond ETF' but the house is Edelweiss) — those are hand-corrected here and would be wrong under a naive first-row-prefix guess. amfi_ter.py normalizes both this value and funds.amc before comparing (lowercase, '&'->'and', collapse whitespace, drop 'mutual fund'/'amc'/'asset management'), so minor wording differences are tolerated. Unknown/new MF_IDs not present here fall back to a best-effort longest-common-prefix guess at runtime and are logged so the operator can curate them in. Edit freely; this file is the source of truth.
